reason: the sre lens's findings the code or a test must fix

findings.text: sre lens, high: cycle_dispatch_stage emits stage.start for every cycle member at every iteration in ALL runs (not only resume), because the guard is `_cd_iter > 0` with no `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` check; the design document for this issue explicitly names this as Gap 7 and states it is NOT YET FIXED, requiring the guard `if [[ ${_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE:-false} == true ]] && [[ "$_cd_iter" -gt 0 ]]; then`. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:3204; fix: code)

sre lens, medium: _runner_resume_rehydrate silently returns 0 when _artifact_persist_restore fails — no log line and no event are emitted — so an operator cannot distinguish a successful resume from one that ran with absent artifacts; the stale-artifact check downstream only fires for stages that have a manifest-declared primary artifact, leaving stages with no primary artifact path silently unprotected. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:1712; fix: code)

sre lens, medium: _runner_from_stage_preflight swallows _artifact_persist_restore failure with `|| true`, making a git-backend failure (network down, branch absent) indistinguishable from 'artifact was never committed'; both paths produce the same 'has no restorable primary artifact' diagnostic, which will mislead an operator diagnosing a git infrastructure failure as a missing prior-run artifact. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:1735; fix: code)

sre lens, medium: The auto-resume via latest symlink branch calls `readlink -f` to resolve the per-run state directory; if readlink fails (broken symlink, macOS without GNU coreutils), state_dir is set to an empty string and all subsequent artifact and state-file operations use paths under an empty prefix, which silently corrupts or misroutes them rather than failing closed with a diagnostic. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:2215; fix: code)
